# 0.16.1 — 20 October 2026

Patch on 0.16.0. Nothing to regenerate and nothing to do after upgrading. The SDK class is renamed `Opentide`; the old `OpenTide` spelling still imports and warns.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.16.1
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Changed

- **The SDK class names lose their second capital.** `Opentide` (the registry singleton) and `OpentideRegistry` replace `OpenTide` and `OpenTideRegistry`. `from opentide import OpenTide`, `opentide.core.OpenTide` and `opentide.core.registry.OpenTide` / `OpenTideRegistry` still import and return the same objects, with a `DeprecationWarning`. The old spelling goes in a later release.
- The project is spelled `opentide`, lowercase, across the CLI help, docs, generated pipelines and the MCP server name. The `OPENTIDE_*` environment variables and the Elastic rule tag `OpenTide` are unchanged.

## Fixed

- `opentide setup skills` accepts the catalogue manifest's `source` in any letter case. A manifest that spelled itself `OpenTideHQ/skills` logged `Skills manifest source rejected` on every run, although the fallback installed the same catalogue.

## Verify

```bash
pip install opentide==0.16.1
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"   # 0.16.1
opentide --version
```
